sentence: This project studies whether cyclohexanone, an organic solvent contaminant of medical plastics, harms outcomes after neonatal cardiac surgery.
This project tests whether activating an enzyme that clears aldehydes helps human cell models of Fanconi anemia.
This project studies how transcription factors work together to drive signaling in diffuse midline gliomas, a childhood brain tumor.
This project studies how circulating aged T cells and the factors they secrete drive cognitive decline during aging.
This project studies how a ligase protein targets a virulence factor of influenza virus for degradation.
This project tests an imaging tool, a probe-based light sheet microscope, that examines anal tissue cells non-invasively to screen for anal cancer.
This project studies how medical marijuana affects pain, daily functioning and quality of life in older adults with chronic pain.
This project develops fixed-target methods for time-resolved X-ray crystallography to see how molecules change their structure.
This project uses CRISPR and human pluripotent stem cells to model dominant optic atrophy and study how retinal ganglion cells degenerate.
This project studies how ethanol changes the endocannabinoid system, a signaling system in the brain, along specific projections.
This project uses machine learning to compare immune responses to influenza vaccine in healthy weight and obese older adults.
This project studies how RNA is regulated in gene expression and how disease affects that regulation, using nucleotide recoding chemistry.
This project expands an open-source platform that lets researchers design and run laboratory automation workflows using Python.
This project studies how a key enzyme of rotavirus works during infection.
This project builds automated tools that pull data on post-translational modifications from publications and score the quality of evidence in Alzheimer's disease research.
This project uses human lung cell lines to study how transporter gene mutations cause respiratory distress syndrome and interstitial lung disease.
This project studies how members of a protein family control autophagy in different cell types during development and adulthood.
This project studies how the brain produces hormone-dependent risk taking in females.
This project develops a genome editing therapy for Huntington's disease that is delivered into brain tissue by intracranial injection.
